messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT 1259 — Sev2: Function-calling errors observed from tenant brightpath (dedicated pool dp-az1-brightpath). Automatic paging to @maria and @sam.

maria: pinging in — seeing elevated 5xx from our webhook proxy for Brightpath. Customer reports 30% of calls failing since 09:12 UTC.

brightpath-support-bot: Customer-side logs: 400 Bad Request from Brightpath ingestion endpoint — payload parse error: "Unexpected token ',' at position 112".

sam: copying logs — failures all share: function_call response body not valid JSON / trailing commas. Looks like a parser/formatter regression in the func-calling postprocess. Not all invocations, seems tied to a particular model variant we rolled yesterday to dedicated pool.

maria: confirmed: last deploy to dp-az1-brightpath at 08:57 UTC contained fc-postproc v3.4.7 -> v3.5.0. Reverting should be straightforward. Need mitigation that doesn't require full restart (customer critical).

david: suggested mitigation: temporarily route Brightpath requests to the prior model variant (gpt-j-rc1) and disable func-calling on dp pool for Brightpath so they get raw text until fix. I can run the route change.

tara: I'm on customer comms. If we set expected ETA 30m for mitigation and 2h for full fix, Brightpath SLAs will be covered. Will advise them about temporary degraded feature (no structured tools).

sam: mitigation steps I'm about to run:
```
# route Brightpath traffic to fallback model variant
redwood route set --tenant brightpath --pool dp-az1-brightpath --model gpt-j-rc1 --priority 900
# disable function-calling on tenant to avoid malformed json payloads
redwood tenant-config set --tenant brightpath --key enable_function_calling --value false
```

maria: @david please standby for the rollback of postproc. If route change fails we may need hotfix.

david: starting rollback of fc-postproc on dp-az1-brightpath nodes (will do canary then scale):
```
# deploy rollback job
redwood deploy job --pool dp-az1-brightpath --image redwood/fc-postproc:v3.4.7 --canary 2
```

ops-bot: deploy job queued (job id dj-8621). Expect ~4m to canary ready.

maria: meanwhile @tara—customer wants logs and proof of rollback. Can you prepare a succinct status with: what happened, impact, mitigation, ETA? Keep it short.

tara: on it. Drafting now.

ops-bot: canary instances healthy after 3m; running validation.

sam: route update returned 200, traffic now split 10% to fallback model for tests, 90% still live. I'm increasing to 60% to reduce blast radius of malformed outputs.

brightpath-support-bot: Brightpath confirms ingestion errors dropped by 80% after the route change. Still seeing occasional malformed payloads from older sessions.

david: canary looks good, promoting rollback to remaining nodes now. Rolling updates expected 12m.

maria: coordinating handoff — I need to drop for a client meeting in ~20m. @sam you take lead on remediation and postmortem prep. I will update on-call log.

sam: taking over. I'll monitor error rate, finish routing to fallback if needed, and follow-up with a patch PR for parser sanitization + stricter JSON schema validation. Tagging engineering-runtime for code review.

ops-bot: full rollback complete on dp-az1-brightpath. Error rate for Brightpath ingestion endpoint returned to baseline.

brightpath-support-bot: Customer confirms success, they will run verification tests and report any residual issues. Thanks.

sam: next actions (short):
- open PR to add strict JSON emitter & trailing-comma guard (linked to ticket INF-2113)
- add test in e2e for function-calling outputs that validates strict JSON and schema against example tool contract
- run canary of patch in staging then schedule a safe upgrade for dp pools in 48h window

tara: sent customer update: brief summary + mitigation + ETA for full fix (48h). Asked if they'd like a postmortem call.

maria: leaving notes in oncall doc, handing to @sam. Good job all. :thumbsup:

sam: will run postmortem draft and include timeline, root cause (postproc v3.5.0 introduced permissive serializer that left trailing commas), impact (Brightpath ingestion 30% failures, degraded features), mitigations applied (routing to fallback, disable func-calling, rollback), and follow-ups (INF-2113, e2e tests, deployment gating).

ops-bot: incident 1259 -> resolved (status: mitigated).

sam: I'll keep the thread open for any follow-ups from Brightpath or eng-runtime.
